recipes.ordinary: Two slanted vertical baffles: x=.35L+.15(y-Y/2)+jitter and x=.68L-.18(y-Y/2)-jitter, thickness2, z<=Z-4; first y<=Y-9, second y>=9. Seed jitter uniform[-.5,.5]. Witness via z=Z-2. Different from old ellipsoid chain.
recipes.narrow: Solid workspace carved into an S-shaped union of axis-aligned rectangular corridors (height6), start and goal rooms width8. Centreline: (5,6,8),(.30L,6,8),(.30L,.55Y,8.5),(.65L,.55Y,8.5),(.65L,Y-6,9),(L-5,Y-6,9), with half-grid rounding; width2.5 uses quarter-grid centres for exact aperture. No other free regions. Different from old two pierced walls.
recipes.near_seabed: Trapezoid ridge: h=ceil((3+height*clip(min((x/L-.12)/.28,(.88-x/L)/.28),0,1)+1.5*(y/Y-.5))/.5)*.5; closed seabed and h+6 mission ceiling. Start(5,6,h+3), goal(L-6,Y-7,h+3), dense centre-band witness. Forced climb/descent, unlike old wave/ramp terraces.
